evidence.label: BMW SIB 11 03 17 - N20/N26 Timing-Chain and Oil-Pump Drive-Chain Limited Warranty Extension

after.title: Lower-Engine Whine Requires 428i N20/N26 Timing-Chain Diagnosis
after.description: BMW SIB 11 03 17 identifies specified F32, F33 and F36 428i variants with N20 or N26 engines produced through February 2015. A whining noise from the lower engine area that rises with engine speed can be associated with wear in the timing-chain or oil-pump drive-chain system; the bulletin does not declare every 428i defective.
after.solution: Confirm the exact chassis, engine, production date and VIN eligibility, then have a BMW-qualified technician reproduce the noise and follow the current BMW diagnostic procedure before replacing anything. The historical seven-year/70,000-mile coverage was a limited warranty extension, not a recall, and is not a current coverage promise. ShowMeTheParts returned no exact 2014 428i timing-chain candidate, so no commerce link is approved.
symptoms: Whining from the lower engine area
Noise frequency increases with engine speed
